I can't confirm the 2020 stud fee for Donjuan Triumphant, so I can't say whether it was €12,000, €4,000, or another figure. The team note names those two options but gives no source, and I have no way to check it from here. A reliable answer would come from the stallion's stud book entry, the stud farm's published fee list, or an archived breeding-industry database.

CONFIDENCE: 10
